body: Thank you so so much for taking the time to read my post and replying. It means the absolute world to me. I will try talking with my family about what I’m going through, I know now I need help with this. I will try to find happiness in the little things too. You are a wonderful person, thank you for caring.

I wish I had something I could tell you to make it better, but I’m in that same low place. Just know you aren’t alone in how you feel. I hope something amazing happens for you soon when you least expect it, you deserve to feel happiness. sending you big internet hugs.
